description: State takes reasonable steps to reduce known risks
legal_question: Did the state address foreseeable patterns of gender-based violence
example_evidence: Laws training shelters public education risk assessment data

description: Authorities respond to specific threats and vulnerable situations
legal_question: Did officials act once they knew or should have known of risk
example_evidence: Reports threats protection orders police calls prior assaults

description: State investigates promptly seriously impartially and without stereotypes
legal_question: Was the investigation gender-sensitive and evidence-based
example_evidence: Case files forensic records witness statements interview protocols

description: Perpetrators and complicit officials face appropriate consequences
legal_question: Did impunity or discriminatory enforcement sustain violence
example_evidence: Charging decisions prosecutions discipline corruption records

description: Survivors receive effective accessible and non-discriminatory remedies
legal_question: Did remedies address safety repair health and future risk
example_evidence: Compensation medical care psychosocial support housing legal aid

description: State addresses systemic conditions that reproduce violence
legal_question: Did the state reform institutions rather than only individual cases
example_evidence: Policy reform budget data collection training monitoring
